test_title: PYST 43: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 30 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Five people X, Y, Z, T and U are sitting in a straight row, facing north. There are only two people to the right of Z and only three people to the right of Y. There are only three people to the left of T. Who is sitting in the exact middle of the row?
solution:
Five people **X, Y, Z, T and U** are sitting in a straight row, facing north.

1. There are only two people to the right of Z and only three people to the right of Y.

2. There are only three people to the left of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b8d8420a6aa22cec3f84aaf7a93333731314702d570787329e737c3e3d4b7ff.png] 

Clearly, Z is sitting in the exact middle of the row.

Hence, ‘**Z**’ is the correct answer.
